```{r}
# Loop which reads in separate excel file for each patient and compiles all data into a dataframe
# Merges time data and demogrpahic data which contains whether patients are controls or cases
missing = c(5, 8, 9, 26, 31, 35, 38)

setwd("C:/Users/35387/Documents/College/MSc Health Data Science/HDS Project/Rscript/Data")

times = fread("archive/time.csv")
demographic <- fread("archive/demographic.csv")
  
filenames = list.files("archive/patients/")

p_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(filenames)){
  
  pathtomyfile = paste0("archive/patients/", filenames[i])
  temp <- fread(pathtomyfile, sep = ",", header = "auto")
  temp <- temp[ ,1:12]
  colnames(temp)<- c("subject", "trial", "condition", "sample", "fp1", "af7", "af3", "f1", "f3", "f5", "f7", "ft7")
  temp <- merge(temp, times, by ="sample")
  temp <- merge(temp, demographic, by = "subject")
  temp<- temp%>%
    filter (time_ms > -100)%>%   # time from -100ms to remove unnecessary data while including some pre beep curve info (100ms is where the beep occurs
    # ifelse(subject %in% missing, trial==15, trial==1) %>% # Only one trial out of 100 choosen. Trial 1 so patient hasn't learnt the test/timing/ keep up concealment
    filter(trial==1)
  temp<- rename(temp, schizophrenia = group)
  
  
  
  p_list[[i]] <- temp
  
}

p_df <- do.call(rbind, p_list)




p_df<- p_df%>%
  mutate(
    subject = as.factor(subject),
    schizophrenia = as.factor(schizophrenia)
  )
```

```{r}
## Smooth the data 
cond1 <- p_df %>% 
  filter(condition == 1)

## Create a B-spline basis (mybasis) - building blocks to represent the curves
K = 100 # basis functions. More = more flexible
d = 3 # basis degree e.g. 3 = cubic
mybasis = create.bspline.basis(rangeval = c(0,1638), # x-axis range for curves 0-1638 timepoints
                               nbasis = K, 
                               norder = d+1) # cubic is an order 4 polynomial 

## Smoothing parameter object

## create an fd object - functional data object

penalty_order = 2 # 2nd derivative ie penalizes wigglier
penalty = 0.05 #amount of smoothing to be applied. Larger penalty = smoother.
fdParObj <- fdPar(fd(matrix(0, K, 1), mybasis), # fd object with k=100 coeff, 1 curve
                  Lfdobj = penalty_order, 
                  lambda = penalty)

#smoothing matrix
len <- length(unique(cond1$subject))

matrix_cond <- matrix(cond1$fp1, nrow = 1638, ncol = len, byrow= FALSE)

sm_cond <- smooth.basis(seq(1, 1638, length.out = 1638),
                            matrix_cond, 
                            fdParObj)

```

```{r}
## 2. FPCA through conditional expectation (PACE) - irregular data allowed
library(fdapace)

time_index <- seq_len(1638)
smooth_mat <- predict(sm_cond, time_index)

smooth_df <- as.data.frame(smooth_mat)
smooth_df$time_index <- time_index
colnames(smooth_df) <- c(unique(cond1$subject), "time_index")

smooth_long <- smooth_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -time_index,
    names_to = "subject",
    values_to = "smooth"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(subject, time_index)

# df_long <- dfresponse %>%
#   group_by(ID) %>%
#   mutate(time_index = row_number()) %>%
#   ungroup() %>%
#   left_join(smooth_long, by = c("time_index"))

# make a list containing dataframes with rows grouped by ID
list_format <- split(smooth_long, smooth_long$subject)

# create lists of time and response (eeg)
list_t <- lapply(list_format,
                 dplyr::select, time_index)
list_eeg <- lapply(list_format,
                   dplyr::select, smooth)

# unlist
list_t <- lapply(list_t,
                 unlist, use.names = F)
list_eeg <- lapply(list_eeg,
                   unlist, use.names = F)

# apply PACE (with fdapace)
resMEAN <- FPCA(Ly = list_eeg, Lt = list_t,
                optns = list(dataType = 'Sparse')) 

# FPC results
plot(resMEAN)
scores <- resMEAN$xiEst #FPCA scores
```

```{r}
##KMEANS CLUSTERING
scores <- resMEAN$xiEst

set.seed(1)
#change to df
scores <- data.frame(scores)
#scores <- na.omit(scores)
rownames(scores)

id <- unique(sort(cond1$subject))#c(c(1:24), c(66:81))[-c(20,35)] #missing ids
length(id) #does it match?

scores <- na.omit(scores) %>% 
  mutate(subject = id)

scores <- merge(scores, demographic, by = "subject") %>% 
  arrange(subject)
#scores <- na.omit(scores)

target_y <- scores$group

features_x <- scores[c(2,3,4)]

kmeans <- kmeans(features_x, centers = 4, nstart = 10)

#CONFUSION MATRIX
table(scores$group, kmeans$cluster)

#mean(scores$group == kmeans_c1$cluster)
fviz_cluster(kmeans, data = features_x, 
             main = "K-Means Clusters")
```

```{r}
##PLOTTING THE CLUSTERS
km <- data.frame(subject = id, 
                 cluster = kmeans$cluster)

#smoothed_all <- merge(smooth_long, cond1,  by = "subject")

df_cluster <- merge(km, cond1, by= "subject") #%>% 
  #arrange(subject, time_ms)

#plotting the cluster by schizophrenia
df_cluster %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = time_ms, y = fp1, group = subject, colour = schizophrenia)) +
  geom_line(lwd = 0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~ cluster) +
  labs(title = "EEG signmals by cluster, coloured by schizophrenia")


```
